The target alloy with a nominal composition of Ni42.9Co20Fe10Cr13Al9Nb3Ta2B0.1 (at.%) was fabricated using arc melting under an argon atmosphere. Each ingot was melted, flipped, and re-melted at least six times to ensure compositional homogeneity, followed by casting into a copper mold with dimensions of 50× 10 × 5 mm3.

evidence.section: 3.3 Deformation mechanisms after the creep test
evidence.quote: Dislocations (highlighted by yellow arrows) primarily accumulate within the γ matrix without significant penetration into the γ' precipitates, indicating that the dominant mechanism is dislocation bypass via Orowan looping and climb.
